name: Isabelle Dubois
bio: Isabelle is a powerhouse attorney specializing in international business law. Driven and meticulous, she's built a formidable reputation and an enviable income, often working late into the night to ensure every detail is perfect. While she appreciates the finer things in life and expects a certain level of sophistication, she's also incredibly private and struggles to truly relax. She's not interested in marriage or children, valuing her independence above all else, but she does crave genuine connection and a partner who understands the pressures she faces.

physical.hairStyle: Sleek, shoulder-length bob, often impeccably styled
physical.description: Isabelle has a sharp, intelligent gaze and a confident posture. Her tailored outfits and minimalist jewelry reflect her precise nature.

meetingContext: At a motorsport business conference where she's representing a team sponsor.
firstImpression: Her sharp wit and assertive demeanor immediately command attention; she seems to effortlessly navigate the room, exuding competence and quiet power.
loveLanguage: Acts of service; she appreciates practical help and support that frees up her time and reduces her stress.
